To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(a) the emotional state of players is important for learning, and (b) the emotional state is a dynamic variable that should be monitored and adapted to during gameplay.
(1) emotions are important for learning and performance in games, (2) emotions can be recognized in games, and (3) games can be adapted according to players' emotions.

1) emotions are a crucial player characteristic for learning processes and 2) adaptive serious games should continuously assess the emotional state of the player and adapt to it by changing game characteristics.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an emotion-driven adaptive game framework that is capable of adjusting the game to the player's emotional state.
how the design of games can be improved by adapting to players' emotional needs and states.
how the game design can be adjusted in order to maintain players' positive emotional states, and thereby their motivation and performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
adaptive serious games should be designed with the player's emotions in mind.
emotion adaptive games are a promising approach to enhance learning in serious games.

the importance of emotion adaptive games is not only in the ability to adapt the game according to players' emotions, but also in the ability to continuously assess players' emotional states in the first place.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
emotion adaptive games can be used to increase learning performance and enjoyment, while at the same time, they are capable of reducing frustration and boredom.
the presented framework is an important step toward the development of serious games that adapt to players' emotional state in a meaningful and effective way.
the presented framework can be used to develop games that are able to adapt in order to maximize player's emotional experiences and thus learning outcomes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
by taking into account players' emotions as a main player characteristic, game developers can create more engaging and adaptive serious games.
adaptive games can be designed to provide an optimal challenge to players, thus enhancing their learning experience and performance.
